text:
The patient most likely has decreased dopamine receptors on the post-synaptic membrane. Chronic drug use downregulates D2 receptors, so the patient needs more of the drug to feel normal, which fits the agitated, aggressive insistence on medication. This is more likely than cell death in dopamine-rich areas, which fits a neurodegenerative picture like Parkinson's and not drug-seeking agitation.

CONFIDENCE: 72
